GitHub mitcad/Mitcad#714 (mitcad#2568), the reporter's round boss, opened by cli.move_face_reported (move-face-reported-test.cmake): a plate 86.99 x 81.87 x 10 (Extrude1 F2, Body1), on it a round boss of radius 6.109 joined to it, 20 high and tapered by -1 degree (Extrude2 F4), its top rim chamfered by 1 (Chamfer1 F6). The geometry of cli.move_face_boss_slides, so its volume and centres of mass (the plate's, the cone frustum's less the chamfer's ring).

The report: the wall, the top chamfer and the cap moved by Free Move (12.4, 0, 0) mm, all angles zero (MoveFace1 F7). Previewed, then committed: one body of the same volume and 9 faces, each moved face found by its name; the centre of mass 12.4 times the boss's share along x; the boss's foot a circle of the sketch's radius about the axis moved 12.4 along x, none left where it was. In 0.74.0 the preview failed ("Geom2d_TrimmedCurve::U1 == U2").
